frozen_projection_recalculation.method: For each fold, fixed membership/dependency/publish phases and one-time source opens are added to (sample fit-cache time minus fit-source-open) scaled by full_fit_sequences/sample_fit_sequences and (sample evaluation-cache time minus evaluation-source-open) scaled by full_eval_sequences/sample_eval_sequences. alternate_charge_if_f0_overrun_is_drawn_.interpretation: This alternate accounting would make the conservative 500 MB/s I/O assumption insufficient. The prior 300 MB advisory probe is not evidence of sustained full-cache rate.

decision.conclusion: Conditional cost fit under the unchanged caps, with little remaining delivery margin. The frozen projection still fits if F1 cache and all later phases remain near their projected durations and the separate I/O reserve covers repeated cache passes.
